    What is real, what is stylized

    The r* paths in chapters 1, 5, 6 and 8, the survey series in chapters 5 and 6, and the end-of-sample comparison are traced from Figures 2, 3 and C.1 of the paper. Chapters 3, 4 and 7 use stylized numbers to show the mechanism; they are marked on screen.

    Equations and coefficients

    Equations follow Appendix D of the paper. Coefficients are posterior means of the full model (Model 6, Table 1). Model 2 has no surveys, Model 3 adds the firm survey, Model 6 adds consumer confidence.
